properties.abnormalities_desc: Large tumour in right front flipper and small one on left front flipper where shoulder meets the flipper

properties.fouling_epibionts_desc: One or two barnacles on Carapace but otherwise clean
properties.alive_and_rescued_notes: Local Fisherman came across this turtle and noticed it was floating on the surface, would dive but then would pop back up to the surface suffering from Float.
Was firstly taken to Bstar for assessment and then taken to WTRC.
Taken to turtle clinic at Horseshoe Bay but was dead on arrival.

properties.abnormalities_desc: Algae and barnacle growth on carapace and body. Very emancipated.

properties.fouling_epibionts_desc: Low/moderate coverage of large barnacles and algae on carapace and plastron. Large cluster of barnacles inbetween eyes on head. Some barnacles seen on soft tissues.
properties.abnormalities_desc: Peeling scutes, bone protrusion on plastron, very skinny
properties.injury_desc: Strange circular mark on underside of front flipper
